That Asset reclassification records only dynamic canonical evidence associated with the card and is not a claim that the Asset effect is implemented or behaviorally verified. The integration suite verifies exact frozen authority binding, Gambit deferral until after Tactics, the optional decline path, resumption of later ordinary reveal effects before dice, attacker and defender withdrawal, termination of later reveal effects when withdrawal is chosen, and normal late-withdrawal battle-card cleanup. The authority digest, card and effect inventories, and every classification status count remained unchanged; only the enumerated regression-evidence file set changed, so the classification digest was re-locked after that evidence-only review. Unverified and dynamic-canonical surfaces remain audit debt, not claims of implementation correctness. Any future authority or classification-evidence drift requires explicit review before this baseline is updated.
